lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform with slight narrowing in the mid-section and widening at the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line (Line 1) is a short segment terminating in the upper flank. Isolated white spots are visible between lines 4, 5, and 6 on the mid-ventral region, representing line fragments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots are aligned vertically posterior to the final torso line, creating a pseudo-linear boundary on the haunch.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; two white spots visible on the cheek; distinct white patch at the base of the throat; white banded markings on the forelegs.
